_why: The editorial copy for the published index, kept beside the runs rather than inside bin/site, so what the front page says is a file somebody edits and not a string in a program. Every figure it shows is still read from a run's own evidence.
title: epikrisis — how the Eunoia ecosystem is developing
tagline: Evidence and analysis for the repositories of the Eunoia ecosystem
lede: Epikrisis reads the git histories of the **Eunoia ecosystem** — a group of repositories built around one proof calculus — and asks what actually happened: what was built, what stalled, and where a project's own account of itself differs from its tree. The current census includes **eunoia and paideia**, together with **cvc5 and ethos on main**. Counts and pins are recorded so anybody with the checkouts can reproduce them.

highlight.subject: eunoia-ecosystem-s2
highlight.title: Fourteen repositories, at the September 19 pins
highlight.blurb: The census covers ten registered member repositories, the explicitly requested **eunoia and paideia** projects, and **cvc5 and ethos on main**. Analysis inclusion does not assign ecosystem membership. Stretch 1 covers August 29 through the September 15 handoff; the second window runs from immediately after the handoff to this snapshot. Whole-history counts include every commit reachable from each recorded main-branch pin.
